proof.text: Choose s from Nonempty S. The basic identities show range(d_(p+1)) is contained in ker(d_p) and range(d_0) is contained in ker(epsilon), using LinearMap.range_le_ker_iff.
For a cycle z, evaluate the relevant homotopy identity on z. The term h(d z) is zero, so z=d(h z), giving the reverse inclusion at each positive degree and at degree zero.
Evaluate epsilon h = id on each a in A; h(a) is a preimage, so epsilon is surjective and its range is top.

theorem powerSetComplex_nonempty_contracting :
    Nonempty S →
      (∀ p : ℕ,
        LinearMap.range (powerSetComplexDifferential A S (p + 1)) =
          LinearMap.ker (powerSetComplexDifferential A S p)) ∧
      LinearMap.range (powerSetComplexDifferential A S 0) =
        LinearMap.ker (powerSetComplexAugmentation A S) ∧
      LinearMap.range (powerSetComplexAugmentation A S) = ⊤
